schema_note: Each entry uses the 'signature' shape from docs/oracle/identity/game-identity.schema.json. class=style may be learned from; class=expression is never copied.

this-war-of-mine.description: Survivor state written as graded words on the portrait, not bars or numbers.
Usable objects show small icons in the world; you tap the icon on the object. No action bar.
Noise you make and sounds you hear drawn as expanding rings at their source; unseen rooms dark and hatched.
Side-on cutaway of the shelter; the camera pans across rooms like a dollhouse.
The shelter radio carries prices and weather news the characters also hear.
The charcoal and pencil UI art, frames, icons, title cards and text.

dont-starve.description: Exactly three always-on need badges and a day clock in one corner; positions never move.
Round day clock split into day, dusk and night segments, with the moon phase at night.
Need badges show which way they are moving as well as the level.
Low sanity desaturates and warps the screen and brings shadow creatures and whispers: the meter becomes the world.
Overlay badges drawn in the same inked line and paper texture as the world.
The organ-shaped badges, inventory and crafting art, gothic style, characters and text.

sons-of-the-forest.description: All vitals in one compact round cluster in a bottom corner: health, stamina with vitality outline, three small need rings.
Screen turns grey at critically low health; cold and wet greys part of stamina.
Filled prompt for a press, hollow for a hold; pictogram prompts on objects.
Opening the backpack lays every item physically on a mat; crafting is placing items on a crafting mat.
A chosen blueprint appears as a ghost in the world that fills in as you add materials.
The map is a GPS tracker held in the hand.
The mat, book, GPS and icon art, Kelvin, horror tone and text.

steamworld-dig.description: A short strip of segmented bars (health, light, water) plus money; pickups add whole segments.
As lamp light runs down the lit area around the player shrinks and the mine darkens.
Every tunnel stays dug, so the mine is its own record of where you have been.
Ore pops with sparkle and sound, flies to the player, fills the bag; selling is a coin cascade with rising sound.
Western-steampunk frames, robots, fonts and text.

tiny-glade.description: The held tool is the interface; drag shapes walls and paths; almost no HUD.
Time of day is a sun you move.
Tool icons, procedural look and art.

dorfromantik.description: Remaining tiles shown as a physical stack with its count painted on it.
Goal numbers float over the tile group that wants them, with a flag when done.
Points float up from the tile that earned them; new tiles fly to the stack.
Tile designs, flags, banners and art.

lego-bricktales.description: Building happens in a separate build space with a palette and a physics test; exploring has almost no HUD.
Bricks, minifigures, palette art and text.

9-kings.description: Small hand of cards at the bottom, a year counter, and the board shows every consequence.
Pixel art, card art and kings.

dead-space.description: Health is a light bar on the suit's spine; stasis a ring on the back; ammo a hologram on the weapon.
Inventory, map and messages are holograms projected in the world without pausing.
A path line projected on the floor replaces a hard-to-use 3D map.
The suit, hologram art, horror tone and text.

firewatch.description: No HUD; a paper map and compass held in the hands, collecting notes over the story.
Dialogue through a raised walkie-talkie; choices appear as lines.
The map art, radio, story and text.

journey.description: Flight energy shown by the scarf's length and glyphs; no HUD.
